narration_line: A premium abstract background texture for a UI card element in an editorial healthcare/pharmacy video graphics system. Soft dark warm charcoal-slate gradient (deep warm neutral, NOT pure black, NOT flat grey), with a gentle muted teal/petrol (#2A7F82) glow softly radiating from one edge, subtle fine grain/noise for richness, soft diffused lighting, no hard shapes, no icons, no text, no logos, no photographic subjects, no people, no objects, NO orange, NO coral, NO warm red-orange tones — pure abstract gradient/texture only, teal accent glow instead. Fills the entire frame edge to edge. Clean, premium, minimal, modern editorial aesthetic. High resolution, smooth gradients, no banding, no watermark.
